# Ana Silva

## Role

Ana is the lead engineer on the Atlas project and reports to Carla, with a focus on retrieval quality, data import and the review of every change before it lands in the main branch. The follow-up items are tracked in the shared log, reviewed every week, and closed only when the owner confirms the result in writing.
## Contact

Ana works from the home office on Tuesdays and Thursdays and from the main office on the other days, and answers messages within a few hours.
